verdicts.evidence: TRIVIAL's only call site passes `why`, which is `rest.join(" | ").trim()`, so its argument is already trimmed and String#trim is idempotent. Measured: 1008 padded values over twelve whitespace code points (including NBSP, U+2009, ideographic space and BOM) show zero non-idempotent trim, and the whole 60-fixture probe plus the CLI JSON are byte-identical.

verdicts.evidence: Second occurrence of the same idempotence: TRIVIAL is called only with `why`, itself the result of `.trim()`, so `/^\[.*\]$/.test(s.trim())` and `.test(s)` receive the same string. Measured: 1008 padded values across twelve whitespace code points show zero non-idempotent trim, and the 60-fixture module probe plus the `rules --for --json` and `status` output are byte-identical.
